correction_note: cp-v2 assumed 'CP = round wire-hole only' (CableEntry-only, Contact never counted). User-caught fallacy: CPs are NOT only round holes -- square/clamp entries exist. Evidence: (1) thesis line 1606 derives v_o for 'Kabeleinfuehrung ODER Kontaktierung' -- both classes; (2) connector_constants.TERMINAL_TYPES was always {CONTACT, CABLE_ENTRY}; (3) cp-v2's 'manufacturer-validated' claim rested on only 2/102 parts, and was BLIND (gt_incomplete) on the other 2 known-count parts; (4) arbiter race (results/cp_def_eval.json) against the ONLY part-matched manufacturer ground truth (9 in-scope PXC terminals, Desktop\JSON ConnectionPoints, 18 CPs) scored cp-v2 F1=0.000 -- it found NONE, because PXC clamp entries are Contact-labelled, not CableEntry. Winner (F1 0.388, recall 0.722) = CableEntry (always) + Contact gated by thesis insertion depth >= 1.0mm (drops flat screw-heads/pads, keeps real recessed connection openings).

cp-v3-thesis-connection-classes.description: A CP is every CableEntry component, PLUS every Contact component with thesis insertion depth |v_o - v_s| >= ct_depth_min_mm (drops flat pads, keeps real openings), deduped cross-class within dedupe_mm (CableEntry wins ties). Arbiter-selected: F1 0.388 / P 0.265 / R 0.722 on 9 in-scope PXC terminals vs manufacturer ConnectionPoints.

cp-v2-cableentry-primary.description: SUPERSEDED 2026-07-20 (arbiter F1 0.000 on manufacturer PXC set -- 'CP = round hole only' fallacy). Kept only for provenance/comparison via classes=(CABLE_ENTRY,). A CP is one CableEntry connected component; Contact never counted.

cp-v1-contact-plus-cableentry.description: Historical: CP = Contact+CableEntry connected components, cross-class deduped 10mm, NO depth gate. Arbiter F1 0.329 (better than cp-v2, worse than cp-v3's depth-gated version -- the depth gate is what improves precision: 0.213 -> 0.265).

robot_wire_gate_note_2026_07_24: WIRE/TOOL gate (results/wire_gate.pkl): drops TOOL/actuator openings (Werkzeugeinschub), keeps wire entries. Root cause (OTOPSI_CP_TIPI.md): thesis Contact class = 'Kontaktierung bzw. Werkzeugeinschub' merges contact+tool by design; geometry does NOT separate them (recon AUC 0.61); a learned STRUCTURAL discriminator does (held-out AUC 0.867). End-to-end precision 0.607->0.751 @ thr 0.30. ALSO corrected the old inflated ~0.98 precision. CAVEAT: retrain wire_gate.py when adding a new manufacturer. Applied in robot_cp.extract after the vote.
robot_union_gate_note_2026_07_24: PRODUCT vote policy = vote>=1 (UNION) + wire-gate 0.35. Joint sweep (vote-level x gate-thr, leakage-free GroupKFold-OOF): vote>=1+gate0.35 BEATS vote>=2+gate0.30 on BOTH manufacturers. AUTO tier still vote>=3 so the union's vote-1 CPs surface to REVIEW.

robot_highcp.note: SEPARATE metadata-assisted mode for high-CP(>=11) terminals ONLY (~3% of parts). 7 models (4 product + 3 keig128) x 2 resolutions (6k+9k) -> UNION -> lattice-augmented 25-feat selector (highcp_selector.pkl) -> top-N by cp_count. Cost ~14 forward passes/part. HONEST CAVEATS: family-optimistic (part-out 0.807 vs family-out 0.799); singleton families collapse (2770=0.41); selector trained leave-one-part-out on only 24 PXC parts (18/24 are 327x); needs manufacturer CP count. Base product (0.750) unaffected. Aggressive 9k-aggr+12k pool tried (oracle 0.783->0.866) but family-recall only +0.007 and REGRESSED 3273 -> NOT deployed. Receipt: results/product_f1_receipt.json.
